adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js`, both `addMembers` and `removeMember` only attach a `.then(...)` success handler and do not handle AJAX failures (no `.catch`/error callback). The controller actions also don’t return/await these promises (`addMembers` just calls `this.get("model").addMembers(...)`; `removeMember` calls `self.get("model").removeMember(member)` inside the confirm callback), so a 4xx/5xx (including 422) would result in a rejected promise with no UI feedback. The specific “automatic group” 422 example is less likely from the admin UI because the template hides those controls with `{{#unless automatic}}`, but the silent failure/unhandled rejection issue is still real for other error cases.
